package.name: rover_serial_driver
package.description: A lifecycle node that owns a UART and bridges it to two topics: raw bytes read from the device are published on serial_read, and bytes received on serial_write are written back to the device while the node is active. Forked from transport_drivers' serial_driver (v1.2.0); see README.md for provenance.
